create_optimizer_adamc_schedulefree_plus: create an AdamCScheduleFreePlusPaper optimizer with custom learning rate, betas, and schedule-free momentum parameters
run_step_func_with_function_value: run the step_func method with a function value to perform a Polyak-adaptive optimization step
